latest_release.name: v0.12.2
latest_release.body:
## **LTX for VR180, frame generation, simpler settings and a lot of fixes**

Support on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kruk2) or [Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2). License codes from anywhere else are fake. [More info](https://github.com/Kruk2/jasna#supporting-the-project)
中国用户请通过[闲鱼](https://github.com/Kruk2/jasna/blob/main/README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买)支持。其他渠道都是骗子。

**You can copy model files from previous version**


## New
- **LTX works on VR180 videos** (side-by-side and top/bottom). Both eyes get the same detail. It's not perfect but better than nothing. (#689)
- **2x frame generation** with RTX Video Frame Generation: 30 fps video comes out as 60 fps. RTX 40xx and newer only. Output tab, CLI: `--frame-generation 2x` (#365)
- **Simple, Advanced and Expert settings views.** I removed a few options nobody needed.
- **Standard Quality looks a bit better now.** Basic Quality is the fast one, about 1.7x faster than Standard.
- minimize to tray (#646) (via new gear icon next to language dropdown)
- every video stores now Jasna settings that were used to restore it (#717)
- LTX model downloads continue after a broken connection instead of starting over (#675)
- more Radeon GPUs work. LTX still needs RX 7000/9000 or newer. (#661)

## Activation
- when you activate, pick "This is my PC" (works offline) or "Rented or shared PC" (needs internet)
- you can see which PCs use your License code
- offline activation works on more Intel PCs (#685, #735)
- fixed a PC losing its activation after a VPN drop or a crash

## Fixes
- LTX: less flicker when two mosaics touch
- LTX: no more jumpy restore when a mosaic box grows for a frame or two (#713)
- LTX: fixes for 6 GB and 8 GB cards running out of VRAM (#678, #690, #697)
- LTX: last step is faster on 4K videos with several mosaics, on AMD a lot faster (#718, #726)
- LTX: Ctrl+C stops right away
- a stopped job's output no longer looks complete when it isn't
- jobs with ranges continue where they stopped instead of starting over (#708)
- smart render fixes for AV1 and some H.264 videos (#659, #733)
- segments work with variable frame rate videos (#667)
- AMD: Jasna no longer picks the iGPU when you have a Radeon card (#683, #714)
- Linux: UI scale follows your display setting (#663)
- presets no longer get wiped when Jasna crashes while saving

Remember that first run is slower on new version.
[Alternative Jasna 0.12.2 download](https://gofile.io/d/pSENMTzr)
If you see Defender Antivirus detection - you can wait till Microsoft fixes that false positive or add to exclusion list for time being

detail.readme:
> **The only places to get a genuine License code for the supporter models are [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kruk2), [Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2), and for China the seller in the [Chinese README](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买).** > > **支持者模型的正版许可证码只能通过 [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kruk2)、[Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2) 或 [闲鱼](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买) 获取。** [**English**](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) # Jasna Jasna restores mosaics in videos and images. It is free, has a simple app and a command line, and runs on your GPU. ## Contents **Start here** - [What Jasna does](#what-jasna-does) - [What you need](#what-you-need) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Help and community](#help-and-community) - [Supporting the project](#supporting-the-project) (supporter models) **Advanced** - [How Jasna works](#how-jasna-works) - [Command line](#command-line) - [All guides](#all-guides) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Licensing](#licensing) - [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) ## What Jasna does - Finds mosaics in a video and restores them. The rest of the picture is not touched. - Two restoration models: fast **BasicVSR++** (free) and slow but more detailed **LTX** (for supporters). - Restores only the parts you choose, with a preview, in the **Segment Editor**. - Works with VR180 videos and still images (SD 1.5, for supporters). - Lets you watch a video restored live in the **Video Player**, without making a file. ## What you need - **NVIDIA** GTX 16-series / RTX 20-series or newer, with a recent driver (610+ on Windows, 580+ on Linux). GTX 10-series and older don't work. - Or **AMD** Radeon RX 5000 or newer (experimental). RX 7000/9000 are tested; RX 5000/6000 are untested. - A folder on a local disk, with no Chinese, Japanese, accented or other non-English characters in its path.
More details - NVIDIA: your GPU needs compute capability 7.5 or higher in NVIDIA's [GPU table](https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda/gpus). - AMD: see the table below. UNet 4x secondary restoration is supported. - Disk format: NTFS on Windows; ext4, Btrfs, XFS or ZFS on Linux. Network disks are not supported. Use an SSD; on a hard disk (HDD) Jasna starts and loads models slowly. - LTX needs an NVIDIA RTX or AMD Radeon RX 7000/9000 GPU, at least 8 GB VRAM and 16 GB RAM. See [What LTX needs](docs/en/models.md#what-ltx-needs). | AMD GPU | Jasna | LTX | | --- | --- | --- | | Radeon RX 9060/9070, Radeon AI PRO R9700 | yes | yes (Windows: beta) | | Radeon RX 7600–7900, Radeon PRO W7000 | yes | yes (Windows: beta) | | Radeon 740M/760M/780M/880M/890M, Ryzen AI Max (8050S/8060S) | yes, untested | yes, untested | | Radeon RX 5000/6000, Radeon PRO W5000/W6000 | yes, untested | no | | Radeon 610M/660M/680M/820M/840M/860M | yes, untested | no | | Radeon RX Vega, RX 500 and older | no | no |
## Quick start 1. Download the release for your system and GPU. 2. Unpack it into a folder with no Chinese, Japanese, accented or other non-English characters in the path. 3. Start the app: - Windows: double-click `jasna.exe`. On AMD, first install [AMD's driver for ROCm 10.1](https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/release-notes/RN-RAD-ROCM-10-01.html) (**26.10.41.05**, [download .exe](https://drivers.amd.com/drivers/amd-software-adrenalin-edition-26.10.41.05-win11-b-204865.exe)) and reboot. You don't need to install ROCm. - Linux NVIDIA: run the `jasna` file. - Linux AMD: first install AMD's AMF video runtime once. We tested [AMF 26.20](https://repo.radeon.com/amf/26.20/): ```bash curl -fLO https://repo.radeon.com/amf/26.20/amf_installer_26.20.zip unzip amf_installer_26.20.zip sudo bash amf_installer_26.20.sh ``` Accept AMD's license when prompted, then run `run_jasna_amd.sh`. If using Distrobox, install AMF inside the same container as Jasna. 4. Add a video, choose settings and click the **▶** button at the bottom. **Your first job is slow.** On NVIDIA, Jasna first prepares the models for your exact GPU. This takes about **15–60 minutes**, only once. Close other apps and don't use the PC during this time. When you update Jasna, copy the `model_weights` folder to the new version, so you don't wait again. LTX may still ask to download its model again after an update. On AMD, only UNet 4x needs this preparation, on its first use. Every setting has a tooltip: move the mouse over the ⓘ icon. Out of GPU memory (VRAM)? Lower **Max Clip Size**, for example from `90` to `60`. See [Tuning](docs/en/tuning.md). ## Help and community - [App guide](docs/en/gui.md): the queue, presets, output names, the Video Player and activation. - Problem? Click **Logs** at the bottom of the app, then **Export** to save a log file. Attach it when you ask for help. ## Supporting the project Jasna is free. Your support pays for training new models, mostly GPU rental. Supporters get a License code for the supporter models: | Support | Models | | --- | --- | | **$15 USD** (Ko-fi: **14 EUR**) or more in total | **UNet 4x**: makes restored areas sharper.
**SD 1.5**: experimental model for still images. | | **$25 USD** (Ko-fi: **23 EUR**) | **UNet 4x** and **SD 1.5**, plus
**LTX**: much slower than BasicVSR++, but more detail. Includes future updates of this LTX model. | Supporters who gave **$15 USD or more on or before 14 October 2026** get LTX for free. **Before you choose LTX:** - Run LTX in **Trial mode (speed test)** on your PC. It is free and shows if your GPU can run LTX and how long it takes. The video is not restored. See [What LTX needs](docs/en/models.md#what-ltx-needs). ### Where to support License codes come **only** from here: - [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kruk2) - [Unifans](https://app.unifans.io/c/kruk2) - For China: see the [Chinese README](README.zh.md#在闲鱼购买) Anyone else selling Jasna, codes or modified files is a scam: their keys don't work, and their files can run hidden code on your PC. Download Jasna only from GitHub. ### How to activate 1. Support on one of the pages above. You get a **License code**. 2. In Jasna, open **Activate Jasna**, enter the License code, choose **This is my PC** or **Rented or shared PC** and press **Activate**. One License code works on **3 devices at the same time**. To see how many are in use, open **Activate Jasna** again. - **PC with a TPM 2.0 security chip** (most Windows 11 PCs): after one online activation, Jasna works offline. The PC keeps one of your 3 slots. Windows may ask for permission once. A new motherboard or a security chip reset counts as a new PC. - **Other PCs, rented GPUs, and Linux in a container (Docker, distrobox) or virtual machine**: Jasna needs internet while it uses supporter models. A device counts only while Jasna runs. See [Cloud GPUs](docs/en/cloud.md). - Linux with a security chip: to use it offline, run `sudo usermod -aG tss $USER`, restart the PC and activate again. Coming from Jasna 0.11? Your activation carries over the first time you use a supporter model, and Jasna 0.11 keeps working on the same PC. Have an email and key from Jasna 0.10? They no longer work. Get a new License code from where you bought it. ## Advanced ### How Jasna works Almost everything runs on the GPU, from reading the video to saving it. 1. **Decode** the video on the GPU (NVDEC on NVIDIA, AMF on AMD). 2. **Detect** mosaics in each frame (default model `rfdetr-v6`). 3. **Track** each mosaic over time and group its frames into clips (up to **Max Clip Size** frames). Clips end at scene cuts, so two different shots are never mixed. 4. **Restore** each clip as a 256x256 picture with BasicVSR++. Clips overlap a little, so there are no visible jumps between them. 5. Optional **secondary restoration** (UNet 4x, RTX Super Res or Topaz TVAI) makes the restored picture bigger and sharper. 6. **Blend** the restored picture back into the original frame. Only the mosaic area changes. 7. **Encode** with the GPU encoder (NVENC on NVIDIA, AMF on AMD). Audio is copied (encoded again only if the output format can't hold it). On NVIDIA, the first job prepares the models for steps 2 and 4 (and UNet 4x, if used) for your exact GPU; on AMD, only UNet 4x. The result is saved in `model_weights` and used again later. You can copy it to a newer Jasna version. LTX works differently. It goes over the video in 4 passes: find mosaics, prepare, restore with a diffusion model, save. It is slower but can add more real detail. Its quality choices: Basic (about 1.7x faster than Standard), Standard (default), Good (about 1.5x slower), High (about 2.5x slower) and Top (about 5x slower). See [Choosing models](docs/en/models.md#restoration-model). LTX jobs and jobs with ranges can pause and continue. See [Pause and continue](docs/en/models.md#pause-and-continue). ### Command line The command line can do most of what the app does (not the Video Player, LTX seed previews, mask suggestions or interactive image mode). ```bash # One video jasna --input input.mp4 --output output.mkv # One image jasna --input photo.png --output restored.png # A whole folder jasna --input input_folder --output output_folder ``` `jasna --help` lists all options. See the [CLI reference](docs/en/cli.md). ### All guides - [Using the GUI](docs/en/gui.md): queue, presets, output names, Video Player, activation. - [Choosing models](docs/en/models.md): detection models, BasicVSR++ or LTX, secondary restoration, SD 1.5 for images. - [Restoring only parts of a video](docs/en/segments.md): Segment Editor, mosaic scan, LTX only for big mosaics. - [VR180 videos](docs/en/vr180.md): how side-by-side and top/bottom VR are handled. - [Tuning VRAM and GPU usage](docs/en/tuning.md): clip size, overlap, what to do when VRAM runs out. - [Advanced processing](docs/en/advanced_processing.md): denoise, 60→30 FPS, color LUT, sharpening, encoder quality, settings saved in the video, actions after the queue. - [Streaming](docs/en/streaming.md): watch in the browser or in Stash. - [Cloud GPUs](docs/en/cloud.md): Jasna on a rented GPU (RunPod, Vast). - [CLI reference](docs/en/cli.md): all command line options. - [Running from source](docs/en/development.md): for developers. From source you can use the free BasicVSR++; activation and supporter models need the official release. ### Benchmarks Time to restore a whole 3:22 video with BasicVSR++ on an RTX 5090 (Linux). Lower is better. | Input | Jasna v0.4.1 | Jasna v0.9.1 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | 720p H.264 | 01:35 | **00:32** (3.0x faster) | | 1080p H.264 | 01:46 | **00:34** (3.1x faster) | | 2160p H.264 | 03:23 | **01:03** (3.2x faster) |
GPU memory, older versions and how it was measured GPU memory used (typical / peak, in GB). `—` means not measured. | Input | v0.4.1 | v0.5.0 | v0.9.0 | **v0.9.1** | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | 720p H.264 8-bit | 17.6/19.9 | 8.6/9.0 | 8.6/9.1 | **4.2/4.6** | | 1080p H.264 8-bit | 18.9/21.4 | 9.5/10.2 | 9.3/10.1 | **4.8/5.6** | | 2160p H.264 8-bit | 26.0/30.5 | 12.9/15.0 | 11.4/15.4 | **7.2/10.9** | | 8K VR HEVC 60 fps (15 s) | — | — | 17.1/18.3 | — | Times for older versions (v0.5.0: 00:45 / 00:47 / 01:22; v0.9.0: 00:34 / 00:39 / 01:15 for 720p / 1080p / 2160p; 8K VR: 00:34), the test settings, RAM use and every codec are in the [full benchmark report](benchmarks/2026-07-26_release_matrix.md). Older full-length videos: [legacy report](benchmarks/2026-07-26_legacy_videos.md).
### Licensing Jasna's public application source is AGPL-3.0. Models and bundled dependencies keep their own terms. See [licensing and source availability](LICENSING.md), [model notices](assets/THIRD_PARTY_MODELS.md) and the [release source correspondence](RELEASE_SOURCES.md). ### Acknowledgments - **Lada**: Jasna is inspired by Lada and in some places based on it. The `mosaic_restoration_1.2` model used by Jasna was trained by ladaapp, the author of Lada. - **ZeLeFans**: for the VR detection model and the detailed analysis of mosaic shapes and VR projection.
